Definition: the Nethinim, or Temple-servants (as given to that duty)
BiblicalUsage: The Nethinim are counted among the first to return from exile and settle in their cities, named in the lists of Ezra and Nehemiah among the temple servants. David and the princes gave them to serve the Levites in the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the temple servants show what serving God really looks like: they have no great name and no story of their own, only the honour of being given to God's house. That is enough.
